_comment: Safety baseline for verify-sports-sync.test.ts test 21. `byteForByte` entries must not change at all — a hash mismatch means streaming, broadcast, auth or deployment config was touched. `localisedOnly` entries are UI files the i18n work deliberately edited (each diff reviewed as strings and imports only); their hash is pinned so any FURTHER edit fails, and the test separately asserts the streaming behaviour they own, because a hash cannot tell a translation from a logic change. `views/match-detail.tsx` is the relocated `app/matches/[slug]/page.tsx` — a page view, so it belongs with the localised UI files, not with the infrastructure that must never move. These three hashes were re-pinned once more when the broadcast notice under the stream player was routed through `broadcastNoticeKey` instead of being passed to the player as raw Arabic; that diff was imports, one prop expression and comments, with no logic change. vercel.json was deliberately changed once more (2026-10-14, universal fixture discovery) to schedule /api/cron/discover-fixtures daily and the sports-sync catalog/tick jobs; only cron entries were added, no existing entry, header or rewrite moved, and its hash was re-pinned for that reviewed change.
